name: Tiruvannamalai City Municipal Corporation
description: G.O. Ms. No. 103 constituted the corporation with effect from 12 August 2024. The order included the former Tiruvannamalai Municipality and Adiannamalai Reserve Forest. It also included the full areas of 18 village panchayats: Vengikkal, Chinnakangiyanur, So.Kilnatchipattu, Nochimalai, Endal, Thenmattur, Kilkatchirapattu, Melathikkan, Savalpoondi, Nallavanpalayam, Kanathampoondi, Anaipiranthan, Athiyanthal, Adiannamalai, Devanandhal, Adaiyur, Durgainammiyandal and Malappambadi.
